annotations.title: Move a person on a shortlist

description: Move a person of an order's shortlist to another stage (a person who applied hears of it, as on the site), or remove one you added (remove: true; an application is the person's own - move it to rejected instead). Needs the API key of the Alion account that posted the vacancies. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

order_id.description: The order: the id list_orders gives (an Alion vacancy your account posted).

person.description: The person: person_id (p_...), their Alion handle or an alion.io/user/<handle> link.

remove.description: Remove a person you added instead of moving them.

name: move_on_shortlist

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.
